headlines.headline: WARRIORS WIN 2026 NBA SUMMER LEAGUE TITLE AS NO. 11 PICK YAXEL LENDEBORG STARS IN LAS VEGAS
headlines.detail: Golden State beat Memphis in the championship behind a breakout from rookie Yaxel Lendeborg in front of record Summer League attendance; the Nuggets separately matched an OKC offer sheet to retain forward Spencer Jones on a two-year, $12 million deal.

headlines.headline: ALL 32 NFL TEAMS SET TO OPEN TRAINING CAMP BY TUESDAY AS CARDINALS LOCK UP QB JACOBY BRISSETT
headlines.detail: Arizona and Carolina were first into camp July 22 ahead of their Aug. 6 Hall of Fame Game meeting; the Cardinals used the week to sign QB Jacoby Brissett to a new one-year, $15.5 million deal, ending a minor contract standoff.

headlines.headline: SOUTH CAROLINA STARTING LEFT TACKLE JOSIAH THOMPSON OUT FOR THE SEASON WITH A LOWER-BODY INJURY
headlines.detail: Coach Shane Beamer said Thompson will probably miss all of 2026, a significant blow to the Gamecocks' offensive line as fall camps open nationally and Big Ten Media Days run Tuesday-Thursday in Chicago.

headlines.headline: COLLEGE BASKETBALL'S NEW ROSTER-BUDGET ERA SETS A $10 MILLION FLOOR FOR COMPETITIVE PROGRAMS
headlines.detail: Revenue sharing now effectively requires a $10 million minimum roster spend to compete, reshaping recruiting and retention as more than 2,700 players have moved through the transfer portal since the 2025-26 season ended.
